title: git undo commit
text: To undo the last commit but keep the changes staged, run git reset --soft HEAD~1. If you want to discard the changes completely use git reset --hard HEAD~1, but be careful because that deletes uncommitted work.

title: rust borrow error
text: error[E0382]: borrow of moved value: `config`. value borrowed here after move. note: move occurs because `config` has type `Config`, which does not implement the `Copy` trait. help: consider cloning the value if the performance cost is acceptable: `config.clone()`

title: docker prune
text: Free disk space used by Docker with docker system prune -a --volumes. It removes stopped containers, unused networks, dangling and unused images, and build cache. Check usage first with docker system df.

title: python venv
text: Create an isolated Python environment with python3 -m venv .venv and activate it with source .venv/bin/activate on macOS or Linux, or .venv\Scripts\activate on Windows. Then install packages with pip install -r requirements.txt.

title: postgres connection refused
text: psql: error: connection to server at "localhost" (127.0.0.1), port 5432 failed: Connection refused. Is the server running on that host and accepting TCP/IP connections? Start it with sudo systemctl start postgresql and check pg_hba.conf.

title: kubectl logs
text: To see logs from a crashed pod use kubectl logs my-pod --previous. Add -f to follow live output and -c container-name when the pod has several containers. kubectl describe pod shows recent events like OOMKilled.

title: regex email
text: A simple regular expression to roughly validate an email address is ^[^@\s]+@[^@\s]+\.[^@\s]+$ . It is not RFC compliant, so for real validation send a confirmation link instead.

title: ssh key
text: Generate a new SSH key with ssh-keygen -t ed25519 -C "laptop". Copy the public key to the server using ssh-copy-id user@host, then disable password login in /etc/ssh/sshd_config by setting PasswordAuthentication no.

title: photosynthesis slide
text: Photosynthesis. Light reactions occur in the thylakoid membranes and produce ATP and NADPH. The Calvin cycle in the stroma uses that energy to fix carbon dioxide into sugar. Chlorophyll absorbs mostly red and blue light and reflects green.

title: mitochondria notes
text: Lecture 4 notes: mitochondria are the site of cellular respiration. Glycolysis happens in the cytoplasm, the Krebs cycle in the matrix, and the electron transport chain on the inner membrane produces most of the ATP.

title: french revolution
text: History seminar: the storming of the Bastille on 14 July 1789 marked the start of the French Revolution. Causes included a fiscal crisis, bad harvests and high bread prices, and Enlightenment ideas about popular sovereignty.

title: derivative rules
text: Calculus review. Power rule: the derivative of x^n is n x^(n-1). Product rule: (fg)' = f'g + fg'. Chain rule: the derivative of f(g(x)) is f'(g(x)) g'(x). Practice problems due Friday.

title: supply and demand
text: Economics 101: when the price of a good rises, quantity demanded usually falls. A price ceiling below the equilibrium price causes a shortage, while a price floor above equilibrium, such as a minimum wage, can cause a surplus.

title: quarterly review moved
text: Priya: The quarterly review moved to Thursday at 3pm in the large conference room. Sam: Can you share the budget spreadsheet before then? Priya: Sure, I will send the Q3 forecast tonight.

title: standup notes
text: Standup 12 Oct: Alex finished the login page redesign. Mei is blocked on the payments API because the sandbox keys expired. Jordan will pair with Mei this afternoon. Release candidate planned for next Wednesday.

title: vendor contract
text: Reminder from legal: the vendor contract with Northwind auto-renews on 1 December unless we give 60 days written notice. Send the termination letter to procurement before the end of September if we want to switch suppliers.

title: hiring plan
text: Hiring plan for next year: two backend engineers, one designer, and a data analyst. Budget approved by the CFO is 480k. Interviews start in January and the recruiter is Dana from the talent team.

title: offsite agenda
text: Team offsite agenda: Monday arrive and dinner at the lake house, Tuesday strategy workshop and product roadmap, Wednesday hiking and a retrospective. Remember to bring laptops and rain jackets.

title: banana bread
text: Banana bread recipe: mash three ripe bananas, mix with 75 g melted butter, 150 g sugar, one egg and a teaspoon of vanilla. Fold in 190 g flour and a teaspoon of baking soda. Bake at 175 C for about an hour.

title: sourdough starter
text: Feeding the sourdough starter: discard half, then add equal weights of flour and water, about 50 g each. Keep it at room temperature and it should double in four to six hours when it is active.

title: flight booking
text: Booking confirmation ABX92K. Flight LH 431 from Chicago O'Hare to Frankfurt departs 17:50 on 3 November, seat 34A. Checked baggage allowance one bag of 23 kg. Online check-in opens 23 hours before departure.

title: hotel lisbon
text: Hotel reservation in Lisbon, Alfama district, check-in 12 May after 3pm, check-out 16 May before 11am. Breakfast included. Free cancellation until 48 hours before arrival. The tram 28 stops nearby.

title: passport renewal
text: Passport renewal: fill out the form online, attach a recent photo with a white background, and pay the fee. Standard processing takes six to eight weeks; expedited service costs extra and takes two to three weeks.

title: dentist appointment
text: Dentist appointment for a cleaning and check-up on Tuesday 9 April at 8:30 with Dr. Okafor. Arrive ten minutes early to update insurance details. Call the clinic to reschedule at least a day in advance.

title: running plan
text: Half marathon training week 6: easy run 5 km on Monday, intervals 6 x 800 m on Wednesday, tempo run 8 km on Friday, and a long run of 16 km on Sunday. Stretch and hydrate after every session.

title: medication schedule
text: Take the antibiotic amoxicillin 500 mg three times a day with food for seven days. Finish the whole course even if you feel better. Avoid alcohol and call the doctor if a rash appears.

title: wifi password
text: Guest network name OfficeGuest-5G. The network key rotates every Monday; ask reception for the current one. Printers are on the corporate network only, not on the guest network.

title: car service
text: Car service due at 60,000 km: replace engine oil and filter, rotate tires, check the brake pads and replace the cabin air filter. The garage quoted 320 dollars and needs the car for the whole day.

title: home insurance
text: Home insurance policy renewal: premium increases to 1,140 per year. Water damage from burst pipes is covered but flood damage is excluded. The deductible is 500. Compare quotes before the renewal date in March.

title: plant care
text: Monstera care: water when the top few centimeters of soil are dry, roughly once a week, and keep it in bright indirect light. Yellow leaves usually mean overwatering. Wipe the leaves to remove dust.

title: proxy settings
text: Settings > Network > Proxy configuration. Use system proxy settings for all connections. Manual proxy: host proxy.internal port 3128. Bypass proxy for localhost and 127.0.0.1. Last updated 12 minutes ago.

title: book quote
text: Quote from the book I am reading: we do not rise to the level of our goals, we fall to the level of our systems. Small habits compound over time like interest, so focus on the process rather than the outcome.

title: podcast recommendation
text: Podcast recommendation from Lina: an episode about the history of the shipping container and how standardized boxes made global trade cheap. Around 50 minutes long, good for the commute.

title: tax deadline
text: Tax return deadline is 15 April. Gather the W-2 from the employer, 1099 forms for freelance income, receipts for charitable donations, and the mortgage interest statement. Consider filing for an extension if documents are missing.

title: birthday gift ideas
text: Gift ideas for Mom's birthday: a pottery class voucher, a new gardening apron, or framed family photos. Her birthday is on 22 June and she mentioned wanting to learn ceramics.

title: sql join
text: LEFT JOIN returns every row from the left table and the matching rows from the right table, filling NULLs where there is no match. INNER JOIN only returns rows that match in both tables.

title: css centering
text: To center a div horizontally and vertically, make the parent display: flex with justify-content: center and align-items: center. With CSS grid you can use place-items: center on the container.

title: solar panels
text: Quote for rooftop solar panels: 6.4 kW system with 16 panels and an inverter, estimated to cover 80 percent of our electricity use. Payback period about nine years after the tax credit.

title: reunión de presupuesto
text: La reunión de presupuesto con el equipo de marketing se cambió al lunes a las diez. Hay que preparar las cifras de gastos de publicidad del último trimestre y enviarlas a Carmen antes del viernes.

title: receta de tortilla
text: Receta de tortilla de patatas: pelar y cortar cuatro patatas y una cebolla, freírlas a fuego lento en aceite de oliva, mezclarlas con seis huevos batidos y cuajar la tortilla por ambos lados en la sartén.

title: rendez-vous médecin
text: Rendez-vous chez le médecin généraliste jeudi à 14 heures pour le renouvellement de l'ordonnance. Apporter la carte vitale et les résultats de la prise de sang du mois dernier.

title: location appartement
text: Pour la location de l'appartement à Lyon, le propriétaire demande trois fiches de paie, un avis d'imposition et un garant. Le loyer est de 850 euros charges comprises et la visite est prévue samedi.

title: Zugfahrt München
text: Die Zugfahrt nach München mit dem ICE dauert etwa vier Stunden. Abfahrt um 7:12 Uhr ab Berlin Hauptbahnhof, Wagen 25, Platz 61. Die Fahrkarte ist im Handy gespeichert, BahnCard nicht vergessen.

title: Mietvertrag Kündigung
text: Die Kündigungsfrist für den Mietvertrag beträgt drei Monate. Die Kündigung muss schriftlich mit Unterschrift beim Vermieter eingehen, eine E-Mail reicht nicht aus. Wohnungsübergabe mit Protokoll vereinbaren.
